title: 10 Best HR Case Management Software Platforms for 2027
summary: Compare 10 HR case management platforms for 2027, including features, automation, and employee support tools.
body_markdown:
HR teams handle more than payroll and benefits questions. They manage employee relations issues, workplace investigations, policy requests, onboarding workflows, accommodations, and sensitive employee concerns that require structured tracking, privacy controls, and audit trails. The challenge is not whether these requests will come in. The challenge is whether HR can manage them efficiently while maintaining compliance and employee trust.


As HR responsibilities become more complex, organizations increasingly need centralized systems to manage employee requests and streamline internal workflows. For teams still tracking employee issues across spreadsheets and scattered Slack DMs, dedicated case management software can help improve visibility, reduce administrative work, and ensure sensitive requests receive appropriate attention.


This guide covers the best HR case management software for 2027, from investigation-focused platforms to AI-native solutions and Slack-based[HR service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) tools that keep employee support where employees already work.


## **Key Takeaways**


- **Essential HR capabilities:** HR teams should prioritize case management software that supports structured investigations, audit trails, privacy controls,[workflow automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) , and integration with existing HRIS and communication tools.
- **Slack-native employee support:** Unthread provides[Slack-native ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) , private HR workflows, and AI automation across HR and adjacent internal teams without requiring employees to learn a separate portal.
- **Employee relations management:** Organizations handling complex employee relations cases and workplace investigations should prioritize structured documentation, case tracking, and audit trails to support compliance requirements.
- **HR service delivery:** Enterprise HR teams benefit from centralized case management, workflow visibility, and employee self-service capabilities that streamline routine requests.
- **AI-powered automation:** Modern HR platforms can use AI to automate case routing, answer routine employee questions, and improve response efficiency through[AI-powered support](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) and[knowledge management](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) .


## **What HR Teams Should Look for in HR Case Management Software**


HR case management differs from general helpdesk ticketing. An employee relations investigation, harassment complaint, or accommodation request requires more structure, privacy, and documentation than a routine IT access request. At the same time, employees still expect fast responses and a straightforward way to submit concerns.


A strong HR case management platform should help teams:


- Track employee issues from intake through resolution with full audit trails
- Route cases by type, urgency, department, or employee context
- Build and maintain a[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) for policy questions and self-service
- Generate defensible documentation for compliance and legal review
- Connect with HRIS, identity, and communication tools through relevant[integrations](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io)
- Measure performance through SLA tracking, resolution times, and trend[analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io)


The most practical systems let HR teams keep everyday request intake simple while providing the structure needed for complex investigations and compliance requirements.


## **1) Unthread: Slack-Native HR Support with Purpose-Built AI Agents**


Unthread turns Slack, Microsoft Teams, employee portals, and email into a structured internal help desk for HR and cross-functional employee support. It is built for internal teams that need privacy, routing, ticket ownership, reporting, and automation without forcing employees into a separate case management portal.


### **Why It Fits HR Teams**


Unthread is designed for internal support workflows across HR, IT, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace operations. For HR teams, that means employees can ask about payroll, benefits, leave, employee documents, policy questions, onboarding, and offboarding directly in Slack while HR keeps the work organized and private.


A channel such as #hr-help can become a full internal help desk. General questions can stay in-channel when appropriate, while sensitive matters can move into private workflows for confidentiality.


### **HR-Relevant Capabilities**


- [Purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) for triage, routing, and resolution support
- [Private ticketing](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) for HR teams handling payroll, benefits, leave, employee documents, and policy questions
- [Automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) for recurring Tier 1 requests, approvals, escalations, and follow-ups
- Self-learning[knowledge management](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) that turns repeated employee questions into reusable documentation
- [AI analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) for identifying request trends, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities


Unthread is also useful when HR works closely with IT, finance, procurement, legal, and workplace operations. A single employee request often crosses team boundaries, such as onboarding, equipment, system access, payroll setup, and policy acknowledgement. Unthread helps those handoffs stay structured while keeping the employee experience simple.


Lemonade deployed Unthread across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance teams and reports that Unthread automatically resolves about[40% of all tickets](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) that come in across different teams.


### **What HR Should Consider**


Unthread is the clearest fit when Slack is already a primary employee workspace and HR wants to reduce manual triage without adding another place for employees to check. Unthread offers a[14-day free trial](https://unthread.io/pricing?ref=unthread.io) and per-agent pricing, with advanced AI automation and enterprise features available across its higher-tier plans.


## **2) HR Acuity**


HR Acuity is an enterprise employee relations and investigation platform purpose-built for HR teams handling workplace complaints, harassment claims, disciplinary matters, and compliance-sensitive cases.


### **Primary Focus**


HR Acuity is designed specifically for employee relations rather than adapted from IT ticketing, which means the workflows, documentation, and reporting are built around defensible investigations from the start.


### **Key Features**


- Purpose-built AI agent with the olivER assistant
- Anonymous speak-up reporting in 140+ languages
- Built-in investigation methodology with court-ready reports
- Proprietary three-step investigation methodology embedded in software
- managER tool giving managers direct access to company policies and coaching


## **3) Dovetail Software**


Dovetail Software provides HR service delivery and case management with a focus on caseload visibility, workflow management, and employee experience.


### **Primary Focus**


Dovetail offers enterprise HR case management with a focus on employee service delivery, workflow management, and caseload visibility. Pricing is available through custom quotes.


### **Key Features**


- HR Home Console with complete caseload visibility
- HR Copilot GenAI for Microsoft Teams and Slack
- Workday Select Partner with certified integration
- Workflow support for approvals, routing, and escalations
- Knowledge base for employee self-service


## **4) ServiceNow HR Service Delivery**


ServiceNow HR Service Delivery is an enterprise HR service management platform for large organizations with complex employee service, compliance, and workflow requirements.


### **Primary Focus**


ServiceNow HRSD is often considered when HR service delivery needs to operate across multiple regions, policies, approval chains, and enterprise systems. It is practical for companies with established ServiceNow environments and dedicated platform administration.


### **Key Features**


- Employee service center and HR case management
- Workflow design for approvals, routing, and escalations
- Knowledge management for employee self-service
- Now Assist for HRSD (generative AI layer)
- Virtual Agent for automated employee queries
- Employee Document Management providing unified view from hire to retire


## **5) Case IQ**


Case IQ is an investigation and workplace incident management platform built for complex, multi-party investigations requiring detailed documentation and case linking.


### **Primary Focus**


Case IQ is built from the ground up for complex investigations rather than intake-focused case management. It offers highly configurable workflows, multi-channel anonymous intake, and advanced reporting capabilities for teams handling workplace incidents across multiple departments.


### **Key Features**


- Multi-channel anonymous intake (web, email, phone, hotline)
- Clairia AI assistant for case insights
- Highly configurable workflows for complex investigations
- Case linking that automatically flags patterns across separate reports
- Advanced reporting dashboards


## **6) AllVoices**


AllVoices is an employee relations and anonymous reporting platform built with AI from inception, focused on employee trust and speak-up culture.


### **Primary Focus**


AllVoices offers AI-native capabilities for case routing and trend detection while maintaining anonymous two-way messaging throughout investigations. The platform is designed to encourage employees to report concerns without fear of identification.


### **Key Features**


- AI-native platform with automatic case routing
- Anonymous two-way messaging throughout investigation
- Trend detection that surfaces patterns across case data
- Case token system allowing anonymous status checking
- Integration with major HRIS platforms


## **7) Workday HR Service Delivery**


Workday HR Service Delivery provides native case management capabilities within the Workday HCM suite for organizations already using Workday for human capital management.


### **Primary Focus**


Workday HRSD eliminates data silos for Workday customers by providing case management directly within the existing HCM platform. There is no need to sync employee data between systems, and system-of-record accuracy is maintained automatically.


### **Key Features**


- Native integration with Workday HCM (no data duplication)
- Knowledge articles with guided assistance
- Analytics using Workday's reporting engine
- Embedded directly within Workday interface
- Case management tied to employee records


## **8) Applaud HR**


Applaud HR is an AI-native HR service delivery platform built in the post-generative AI era, emphasizing employee experience over process efficiency.


### **Primary Focus**


Applaud positions itself as an AI-native HR case management platform designed for modern employee service delivery. It offers agentic AI that executes transactions directly rather than just providing suggestions.


### **Key Features**


- Aldwych agentic AI that executes transactions directly
- No-code configuration for HR teams (no IT dependency)
- Omni-channel support with auto-generated case metadata
- Rapid deployment (weeks vs. months)
- Employee-first design philosophy


## **9) Deel HR**


Deel HR is a global workforce compliance and HR platform with case management capabilities for distributed teams operating across multiple countries.


### **Primary Focus**


Deel is designed for global workforce management, offering country-specific compliance rules built into its HRIS, anonymous reporting through a dedicated whistleblowing channel, and multi-country payroll integration.


### **Key Features**


- Country-specific compliance rules built into HRIS
- Anonymous reporting via dedicated whistleblowing channel
- Localized contracts and legal change alerts per country
- Multi-country payroll integration
- Coverage in 150+ countries


## **10) LaborSoft**


LaborSoft is an employee and labor relations cloud platform that handles both employee relations and labor relations in one system.


### **Primary Focus**


LaborSoft supports both employee relations and labor relations, making it relevant for unionized environments and organizations with complex labor relations requirements. It offers a single operational login covering both functions.


### **Key Features**


- Centralized employee and labor relations in one system
- HRIS integration via secure SFTP CSV imports
- Customizable alerts, case types, and dashboards
- Configuration flexibility without custom development
- Single operational login for ER and LR

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is HR case management software and why is it important?**


HR case management software centralizes employee requests, workplace investigations, and HR service delivery through structured tracking, documentation, and[workflow automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) . It helps HR teams assign ownership, maintain audit trails, protect sensitive information, and resolve requests efficiently. This reduces reliance on scattered emails and spreadsheets while improving accountability and the employee experience.


### **How can AI improve HR case resolution?**


AI can automate routine employee questions, categorize and route cases, generate draft responses, and identify recurring issues. This reduces administrative work and allows HR staff to focus on complex matters requiring human judgment. Unthread's[purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) support automated triage and resolution, while its[self-learning knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) helps answer recurring questions using existing documentation.


### **Can HR manage cases directly within Slack?**


Yes. Unthread's[Slack-native ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) allows employees to submit HR requests directly in Slack while HR teams manage assignments, routing, and resolution through structured workflows. Sensitive matters can be handled through private tickets and DMs, helping maintain confidentiality. This approach keeps employee support within familiar communication tools while providing HR teams with centralized case management.


### **What security standards should HR look for?**


HR teams should prioritize SOC 2 Type II compliance, role-based access controls, audit trails, SSO, and appropriate data protection measures. HIPAA compliance is also relevant when handling protected health information. Unthread maintains[SOC 2 Type II compliance](https://unthread.io/security?ref=unthread.io) and offers Business Associate Agreements for eligible Enterprise customers with HIPAA requirements.
